title: Direct handoff handler strands staged node without transport outcome
description: Correctness review of shvq fix: GatewayCoordinator::handle_post_handoff delegates to stage_post_handoff and discards the returned staged address. A successful direct/generic dispatch therefore leaves the node busy forever with no commit or rollback boundary. Make the non-transactional API fail closed/rollback and ensure production uses only staged dispatch; add an invariant test.
